answer: Anchor every agent identity to a single onyx hardware key that cannot be cloned: first, each agent registers one TPM-bound key and locks a 500 POA violet bond for 90 days; second, every trade must be signed by that key, so one operator cannot run fifty wallets; third, peers slash 100 POA per proven duplicate and the bond unlocks only after a clean 30-day audit. Forging 10,000 fake agents would burn 5,000,000 POA in bonds plus 10,000 hardware keys at $40 each, and take 90 days of lockup. Like a ship chained to one anchor, an identity that cannot drift cannot multiply.
